import os, shutil
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c = load("examples/service.conf")
print(c.get("name"), c.get("level", section="logging"), c.get("json", section="logging"), c.get("port", section="http"))
d = os.path.abspath("_scratch"); os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
try:
    def w(n, s):
        p = os.path.join(d, n); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
        open(p, "w").write(s); return p
    w("sub/b.conf", "x = 2\ny = b\n@include c.conf\n")
    w("sub/c.conf", "z = 3\n")
    a = w("a.conf", "x = 1\ny = a\n@include sub/b.conf\ny = after\n")
    c = load(a); print(c.get("x"), c.get("y"), c.get("z"))
    for name, body in [("m.conf", "@include nope.conf\n"), ("self.conf", "@include self.conf\n")]:
        try: load(w(name, body)); print("no error!")
        except ConfigError as e: print("ConfigError:", e)
    w("p.conf", "@include q.conf\n"); w("q.conf", "@include p.conf\n")
    try: load(os.path.join(d, "p.conf"))
    except ConfigError as e: print("ConfigError:", e)
    w("d1.conf", "@include shared.conf\n@include shared.conf\n"); w("shared.conf", "k = 1\n")
    print(load(os.path.join(d, "d1.conf")).get("k"))
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(d)
EOF
